title: How to reverse M-PESA you sent to the wrong number
dek: Act fast, use the official 456 channel, and never trust a stranger who calls offering to help.
body: Sending money to the wrong number happens to almost everyone. Safaricom has an official way to request a reversal by SMS.

steps: Find the M-PESA confirmation message for the wrong transaction.
Forward the whole message, unchanged, to 456.
Wait for a reply from Reversal confirming your request has started. Safaricom says an update comes within two hours.
Watch for further messages from Reversal on the outcome. The person who received the money is contacted before the reversal is completed.

body: Use Hakikisha: when sending money, M-PESA shows the recipient's registered name before you confirm. Read it every time.

A common trick is a message or call claiming money was sent to you by mistake and asking you to send it back. Real reversals only happen through Safaricom's own Reversal channel. Check your actual M-PESA balance before doing anything, and never send money to a number that calls you about a reversal.
